title: 01 - Home Overview
description: ¿Está todo bien ahora mismo? Visión ejecutiva de actividad, alertas y estado actual del hogar.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)

WITH latest AS (SELECT entity_id, domain, event_time, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, bronze_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM tfm.silver.matter_events) SELECT count_if(event_time >= current_timestamp - INTERVAL '15' MINUTE OR domain IN ('button', 'event', 'update', 'select', 'number')) AS value FROM latest WHERE rn = 1

WITH latest AS (SELECT entity_id, domain, quality_flag, event_time, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, bronze_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM tfm.silver.matter_events) SELECT count_if(quality_flag <> 'ok' OR (domain NOT IN ('button', 'event', 'update', 'select', 'number') AND event_time < current_timestamp - INTERVAL '24' HOUR)) AS value FROM latest WHERE rn = 1
SELECT CAST(to_unixtime(max(event_time)) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AS value FROM tfm.silver.matter_events

WITH latest AS (SELECT entity_id, domain, friendly_name, state, numeric_state, unit, event_time, quality_flag, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, bronze_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE domain IN ('light', 'switch', 'binary_sensor', 'lock', 'cover', 'sensor')) SELECT replace(coalesce(friendly_name, entity_id), '[SYN] ', '') AS dispositivo, domain AS tipo, coalesce(CAST(numeric_state AS varchar), state) AS valor, unit, quality_flag AS calidad, event_time AS ultima_actualizacion FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY ultima_actualizacion DESC LIMIT 100
